Asha (Product): I'll present the product + quick architecture. Prefer Fri 09:00. Deck will be 10-12 slides, with two screenshots for fallback.

Rohan (Eng): Ill do the demo. Plan: model snapshot v2026-04-01, prewarm 5m prior, cached fallback JSON and 30s recorded clip ready.

Leo (Sales): Add a hidden registration checkbox: "Interest: pilot/pricing/benchmark". Map pilot->AE-Pilot, pricing->AE-Enterprise. Post-webinar follow-up within 48h.

Asha (Product): I'll draft the host lines for handoffs and fallback (2 sentences).

Rohan (Eng): Staging snippet for ops in backstage:
```
PREWARM_URL=https://staging.demo.internal/prewarm
curl -X POST $PREWARM_URL -H "Authorization: Bearer STAGE-DEMO" -d '{"prompt":"warm"}'
```
Fallback: s3://redwood-webinars/apr12/fallback.mp4 and /demo-fallback.json

Eve (Marketing): Action items due: bios + deck (Asha) by Apr 8, demo infra + fallback (Rohan) by Apr 8, reg fields (Leo) by Apr 8, Zoom invites (Omar) by Apr 8. Rehearsal locked for Fri Apr 10 09:00.
